_doc: Payloads of the stock MidiRpc Ping reply (after the reply type byte) and the model name each decodes to (null: none). Read by packages/dk-session/tests/identify.test.ts and packages/patchkit/src/flash_rpc.rs. Layouts: plain `u8 blobLen, blob, NUL-ended strings`; length-prefixed `u8 rest, u8 blobLen, blob, strings` where `rest` is the number of bytes after the blobLen byte (the Syntakt 1.42 reply, finding 144).

cases.name: plain, text after the name is ignored
plain, a damaged name with control bytes
length-prefixed, a name with a high byte
